run_collision_driver_collision: run collision detection on MJX model and data to compute contact information between all geoms
build_geom_pairs_iterator: build an iterator yielding geom pairs to check for collisions based on contype, conaffinity, and exclusion rules
create_collision_func_lookup: create a lookup of pair-wise collision functions mapping geom type tuples to their collision implementations
test_collision_func_exists: test whether a collision function exists for a given pair of geom types
build_condim_array: build an array of contact constraint dimensions for a model based on geom groups and collision function outputs
